   131	  // constructor, calls captured toISOString via Reflect.apply, then re-parses to verify
   132	  // the produced string round-trips to the exact same ms. Any divergence (post-load
   133	  // tampering, Symbol.toPrimitive shenanigans, etc.) → null → caller blocks.
   134	  function _canonicalIso(ms) {
   135	    try {
   136	      if (typeof ms !== 'number' || ms !== ms || !_CAPTURED_NUMBER_IS_FINITE(ms)) return null;
   137	      var d = new _CAPTURED_DATE_CTOR(ms);
   138	      var iso = _CAPTURED_REFLECT_APPLY(_CAPTURED_DATE_PROTO_TO_ISO, d, []);
   139	      if (typeof iso !== 'string' || iso.length === 0) return null;
   140	      var roundTrip = _CAPTURED_DATE_PARSE(iso);
   141	      if (typeof roundTrip !== 'number' || roundTrip !== roundTrip || roundTrip !== ms) return null;
   142	      return iso;
   143	    } catch (e) { return null; }
   144	  }

   156	  function _containsReservedHostileToken(s) {
   157	    if (typeof s !== 'string') return false;

   207	    if (!_nonEmptyStr(s)) return false;

   212	  function _i18nKeyOk(s) {
   213	    if (!_nonEmptyStr(s)) return false;
   214	    if (s.length > I18N_KEY_MAX_LEN) return false;
   215	    if (!_reTest(I18N_KEY_RE, s)) return false;
   216	    return true;
   217	  }
   218	  function _hasSymbolOwnKey(o) {
   219	    try {
   220	      var syms = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_SYMS(o);
   221	      return _CAPTURED_ARRAY_IS_ARRAY(syms) && syms.length > 0;
   222	    } catch (e) { return true; }
   223	  }
   224	  function _snapshotPlain(o, allowedKeys, invalidCode) {
   225	    if (!_isOriginalPlainObject(o)) return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.PROTOTYPE_POLLUTION_REJECTED], detail: 'not plain' };
   226	    if (_hasSymbolOwnKey(o)) return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'symbol own key' };
   227	    var names;
   228	    try { names = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(o); }
   229	    catch (e) { return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'desc fail' }; }
   230	    var snap = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_CREATE(null);
   231	    for (var i = 0; i < names.length; i++) {
   232	      var k = names[i];
   233	      if (_arrIndexOf(allowedKeys, k) === -1) {
   234	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode, CODES.UNKNOWN_OWN_KEY], detail: 'unknown key ' + k };
   235	      }
   236	      var d;
   237	      try { d = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_DESC(o, k); }
   238	      catch (e) { return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'desc inaccessible' }; }
   239	      if (!d || d.enumerable !== true) return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'non-enum ' + k };
   240	      if (typeof d.get === 'function' || typeof d.set === 'function') {
   241	        return { valid: false, reasonCodes: [invalidCode], detail: 'accessor ' + k };
   242	      }
   243	      snap[k] = d.value;
   244	    }
   245	    return { valid: true, snapshot: snap };
   246	  }
   247	  function _deepFreeze(v) {
   248	    if (v === null || typeof v !== 'object') return v;
   249	    try { _CAPTURED_OBJECT_FREEZE(v); } catch (e) { /* swallow */ }
   250	    var keys;
   251	    try { keys = _CAPTURED_OBJECT_GET_OWN_NAMES(v); } catch (e) { return v; }
   252	    for (var i = 0; i < keys.length; i++) {
   253	      var child;
   254	      try { child = v[keys[i]]; } catch (e) { continue; }
   255	      _deepFreeze(child);
   256	    }
   257	    return v;
   258	  }

   265	  function _toHex8(h) {
   266	    var hexChars = '0123456789abcdef';
   267	    var out = '';
   268	    var x = h >>> 0;
   269	    for (var i = 7; i >= 0; i--) {

   272	      // avoiding ambient String.prototype.charAt.

   109	  function hasNonPlainNestedObject(o) {
   110	    // Codex E1-R1-01 closure: recursive descriptor audit. Walks every nested object/array
   111	    // descriptor, rejecting Symbol-keyed own keys, non-enumerable own keys, accessor
   112	    // (get/set) descriptors, non-plain prototypes (class instances / Proxy targets /
   113	    // arbitrary class), and sparse-array hole patterns.
   114	    //
   115	    // Codex E1-R2-01 closure: traversal overflow MUST fail closed (return true). Previous
   116	    // code returned false (clean) when the visit cap was hit, which let a hostile attacker
   117	    // hide a Symbol-keyed / accessor / non-plain object beyond node 4096. The walk now
   118	    // tracks both depth and node count; overflow on either dimension → reject. Depth is
   119	    // tracked per-node via parallel stack so depth>32 also triggers reject.
   120	    try {
   121	      var MAX_DEPTH = 32;
   122	      var MAX_NODES = 4096;
   123	      var stack = [{ v: o, depth: 0 }];
   124	      var visited = 0;
   125	      while (stack.length > 0) {
   126	        if (visited >= MAX_NODES) return true; // fail-closed on node overflow
   127	        var frame = stack.shift(); visited++;
   128	        if (frame.depth > MAX_DEPTH) return true; // fail-closed on depth overflow
   129	        var v = frame.v;
   130	        if (v === null) continue;
   131	        var t = typeof v;
   132	        if (t === 'function' || t === 'symbol' || t === 'bigint') return true;
   133	        if (t !== 'object') continue;
   134	        var isArr = Array.isArray(v);
   135	        if (!isArr) {
   136	          var p = Object.getPrototypeOf(v);
   137	          if (!(p === Object.prototype || p === null)) return true;
   138	        } else {
   139	          var p2 = Object.getPrototypeOf(v);
   140	          if (p2 !== Array.prototype) return true;
   141	        }
   142	        // Symbol-keyed own keys → reject at any nesting depth.
   143	        var syms;
   144	        try { syms = Object.getOwnPropertySymbols(v); } catch (e) { return true; }
   145	        if (syms && syms.length > 0) return true;
   146	        var names = Object.getOwnPropertyNames(v);
   147	        for (var j = 0; j < names.length; j++) {
   148	          var name = names[j];
   149	          // Array.length is non-enumerable own — skip it from the audit while still
   150	          // walking indexed entries below.
   151	          if (isArr && name === 'length') continue;
   152	          var d;
   153	          try { d = Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(v, name); } catch (eDesc) { return true; }
   154	          if (!d) return true;

   156	          if (d.enumerable !== true) return true;
